shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && rg -n \"afterModelResponse|lastUsage|UsageMetadata\" src test tests specs package.json .lore/test-commands.yml 2>/dev/null"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts; sed -n '1,380p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; sed -n '480,560p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; cat package.json; cat .lore/test-commands.yml 2>/dev/null || true; git status --short --branch; ls -la .lore"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.+#|spec:\" src --glob '*.test.ts' | head -80; rg -n \"function scriptedProvider|function registryReturning|const TOOL_CALL|STOP_FOR_TOOL|STOP_DONE\" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null; rg -n \"validated by\" scripts specs | head -30; cat jest.config.js"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "find src/providers -maxdepth 3 -type f -print | sort; sed -n '1,240p' src/providers/mock/mockProvider.ts 2>/dev/null; sed -n '70,95p' src/types/ai.ts; sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short; git diff --check; git diff --stat; git diff -- specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; sed -n '1,220p' .lore/dod.md; sed -n '1,160p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git commit -m "test(orchestrator): define usage aggregation"'
